10:t_010:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... We risked our lives to protect Earth. We cannot let them do as they please with it.」

10:t_010:9.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll be damned if I let it end like this...!」

10:t_010:10.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$サイデリアル$$... I'll make you pay for this...!」

10:t_010:11.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Prepare to lose your heads. Like hell we'll let you do whatever you want to Earth.」

10:t_010:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「A new war is beginning...」

10:t_010:13.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And it'll be even harsher than any we've fought before...」

10:t_010:14.en:
$n
「Even so, we have to keep moving forward.」

10:t_010:16.en:
$n
(Is my enemy waiting beyond this war...?)

10:t_010:17.en:
$n
(The enemy I've been searching for... The true $$テンシ$$...)

10:t_100:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「How many more...!? How many more do I have to shoot down!?」

10:t_100:1.en:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it...! How can we save Earth!?」

10:t_101:0.en:
$$甲児$$
「The $$ジェミニス$$ we defeated were only a tiny part of $$サイデリアル$$!?」

10:t_101:1.en:
$$甲児$$
「These bastards...! Just how much firepower do they have!?」

10:t_102:0.en:
$$竜馬$$
「If this becomes a slugfest, we're at a disadvantage...!」

10:t_102:1.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Crush their leader, and the battle's over! If I can just find them...!」

10:t_103:0.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I mustn't run away... I mustn't run away...」

10:t_104:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$アル$$... Do you think we can win?」

10:t_104:1.en:
$$アル$$
「The probability of tactical victory is 60%. The probability of strategic victory is...」

10:t_104:2.en:
$$宗介$$
「No, I don't need to hear the rest.」

10:t_104:3.en:
$$アル$$
「I agree. We must first defeat the enemy in front of us.」

10:t_104:5.en:
$$アル$$
「My time with $c has sharpened me, too.」

10:t_105:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A frontal assault with overwhelming force...! They're different from the scheming $$ジェミニス$$...!」

10:t_105:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Can we win...!? Can we... can Earth...!?」

10:t_106:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Why are you attacking Earth!? What are you trying to do!?」

10:t_106:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Answer me! What's the point of any of this!?」

10:t_107:2.en:
$n
(The one behind them has to be...!)

10:t_108:0.en:
$$尸刻$$
「You are the new $$リアクター$$ of the 《$$いがみ合う双子$$》, aren't you?」

10:t_108:1.en:
$n
「This woman...! Is she after the $$ジェニオン$$'s 《$$スフィア$$》!?」

10:t_108:2.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Do not flatter yourself. Merely defeating 《$$ガドライト#keyword$$》 $$メオンサム$$ means nothing to us.」

10:t_108:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Therefore, I shall carry out my mission.」

10:t_108:4.en:
$n
「What a load of crap...! I won't give you my life or Earth!」

10:t_109:1.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Miss $$千鳥$$! Coming to the control room during battle...!」

10:t_109:2.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It's all right, $$マデューカス$$. You have my permission.」

10:t_109:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$カナメ$$... Your fears are perfectly understandable.」

10:t_109:5.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But we have no intention of retreating. This is how we... how $c fights.」

10:t_109:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「I understand, $$テッサ$$... All I can say is...」

10:t_109:9.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$宗介$$... everyone... Please, don't die...)

uncertain: 10:t_010:16-17: Matched the two-row thought break; enemy introduced in the question, then identified in a deliberately trailing fragment.
10:t_102:1: Enemy leader unspecified; used neutral them.
10:t_109:5: Interpreted battle as the team's way of fighting, emphasizing refusal to retreat.
